dashboard.label: Sensors Overview
dashboard.description: Live Linux hwmon (lm-sensors) health: per-host status, current readings, and non-ok (alarm) sensor readings

search.query: index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports

| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "r*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=1h | foreach r* [eval Reading=coalesce(Reading,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - r* | table _time metric_name Reading | rename metric_name as Metric | sort Metric
index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" _raw=*alarm* | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
